plan.title: bug(pr:watch): merged or closed PR is not a terminal verdict; workers wait out SHA-match after squash-merge

narratives.Description: bug(pr:watch): merged or closed PR is not a terminal verdict; workers wait out SHA-match after squash-merge
narratives.Overview:
1. Extend pr:watch so probe/watch fetch REST repos/.../pulls/<N> state and merged (reuse the existing pulls REST surface; no GraphQL gh pr view --json). Place that lifecycle short-circuit ahead of Greptile-body fetch and SHA-match holdout, so a missing Greptile body or sha_match false cannot keep a merged/closed PR in PENDING/TIMEOUT.
2. Named verdict MERGED when merged=true: terminal success, exit 0 (same finish-success family as CLEAN for wait owners proceeding to scope:complete / leftover finalize). SHA-match / missing Last reviewed commit must not hold a merged PR.
3. Named verdict CLOSED_UNMERGED when state=closed and merged=false: terminal non-success, exit 2. Not CLEAN. Workers must treat it as not shipped.
4. Open PRs keep today's SHA-match stale-review guard and the intentional exclusion of sha_match from STALL (#1259 / #2313).
5. Regression tests: merged + sha_match false → MERGED exit 0 immediately; closed unmerged → CLOSED_UNMERGED exit 2; open + sha_match false → still PENDING/poll.
6. Do not invent a third poller outside pr:watch. Do not claim pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge already discharges #4288. Through-merge (#4529 / #4821) mitigation of the Grok implement leaf is context only and is not clearance.
7. Non-goals stay: Greptile thin-HTML Last reviewed parsing (#4289 shipped), #4285 / #4286.

issueCommentThread.body: SHA-parse non-goal from this issue is now filed as #4289 (new Greptile HTML omits `Last reviewed commit:`; shared detector / pr:watch / merge-ready / review-cycle / swarm poller). This issue stays merged/closed terminal only.

Adoption blocker.

This is about Tickets: using GitHub issues to drive the work. A change is supposed to live on its own branch, and the pull request is supposed to point back at the issue that asked for it.

What a new person hits: Merging or closing the pull request is not treated as the end. Workers keep waiting for a match that will not come.

Why that ruins the product for them: They merged, which in GitHub means done, and Directive keeps working as if it were not. The issue tracker and the product disagree about the finish.

How likely: Medium. It shows up at the end of the first pull request, which is late in day one and very visible if they get there.

## Current known state (2026-09-27 Stage A + workflow compare)

Stage A `task triage:evaluate -- 4288` on origin/master `650ab1a614cd`:

- validity: **still-open**
- WIP / open PRs / duplicates: none
- critique-recommend: false (before this chip)
- sink: `.deft-scratch/issue-eval/650ab1a614cd/33d885e2-65e9-45a0-9084-ce8b5ca45cd3`

### Live product gap (unchanged)

`packages/core/src/pr-watch/probe.ts` still does not fetch PR `state` / `merged`. `watch()` terminals remain CLEAN / NEW_P0_P1 / ERRORED / CI_* / STALL / TIMEOUT / PENDING. No `MERGED` (exit 0) or `CLOSED_UNMERGED` (exit 2) arm. Open-PR SHA-match guard is intact and must stay intact.

Companion #4289 (thin HTML SHA pin) shipped; skills still say keep #4288 as the merged/closed terminal. #4286 closed. #4285 open and unrelated.

### Against current Grok through-merge skill (#4529 / #4821)

Through-merge **mitigates** the original recurrence (Grok `drive-to: merge-ready` implement leaf blocked on `pr:watch` after human squash-merge of PR #4287) by requiring implement = `stop-at: pr-open`. That leaf no longer owns `pr:watch`. Approach 1 owns the pre-CLEAN wait; parent-retained / Phase 6 closer uses `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` after CLEAN (that closer already has MERGED exit 0); post-merge `scope:complete` / leftover finalize stays on parent / Phase 6.

Through-merge does **not** satisfy #4288 acceptance:

1. Approach 1 wait still calls `pr:watch` until CLEAN — human squash-merge during `clean_gate_holdout=sha_match` still polls to TIMEOUT.
2. Non-Grok `drive-to: merge-ready` leaves that block on in-process `pr:watch` remain fully exposed.
3. Review-cycle human-merge post-CLEAN observe prose already names REST `pulls/<N>` `merged`/`state`; that is not yet a deterministic `pr:watch` terminal.

### Bound harvest direction (for upcoming arc)

Ship named `pr:watch` terminals from REST `repos/.../pulls/<N>` (not GraphQL): merged → MERGED exit 0 immediately even when sha_match is false; closed unmerged → CLOSED_UNMERGED exit 2; open PRs keep today's SHA-match stale-review guard. Regression tests as in the issue Acceptance.

Catalog facets after evaluate: process, source-of-truth, area:cli, framework-gap (plus prior bug / adoption-blocker / agent-experience / review-cycle / scm / core-capabilities / promise:tickets). Chip stamped `design-critique:mechanism-shaped` for the arc.

## Early REST state/merged short-circuit
sharpens-framing
Evidence: At `650ab1a614cd`, `probeOnce` (`packages/core/src/pr-watch/probe.ts`) hard-requires HEAD SHA then a Greptile body; either miss returns `errorProbe` before any clean-gate fields. `WatchProbe` (`types.ts`) carries no `merged` / `pr_state`. `watch()` (`watch.ts`) terminals only CLEAN / NEW_P0_P1 / ERRORED / CI_* / STALL / TIMEOUT / PENDING / CONFIG. `fetchPrHeadShaRest` already GETs `repos/.../pulls/<N>` but returns only `head.sha`. `watch.test.ts` locks `clean_gate_holdout=sha_match` through to TIMEOUT (no early STALL).
Failure mode: A bind that only adds named verdict arms after a successful Greptile/SHA probe still fails when post-merge Greptile fetch errors or sha_match stays false — the measured hang path never reaches MERGED/CLOSED_UNMERGED.
Disposition: Successor lean must place REST `state`+`merged` ahead of (or independent from) Greptile-body and SHA-match holdout, reusing the existing pulls/<N> REST surface, and keep the open-PR SHA-match guard unchanged.

## Finish consumers must treat MERGED as lifecycle success
sharpens-framing
Evidence: Review-cycle / swarm at this SHA: Approach 1 wait is `pr:watch` to CLEAN; Grok through-merge implement is `stop-at: pr-open` with Approach 1 owning `pr:watch`; Phase 6 closer is `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` only after CLEAN (`deft-directive-swarm` Envelope selection SLA; review-cycle Partner merge-path / Keep #4288). `pr-wait-mergeable/classify.ts` already maps `partial.merged===true` → exit 0 (`merged-by-sibling`) on that closer verb. Issue acceptance wants `pr:watch` MERGED exit 0 and CLOSED_UNMERGED exit 2.
Failure mode: If callers key only on verdict string `CLEAN`, a correct MERGED exit 0 still leaves merge-path owners parked instead of `scope:complete` / leftover finalize; CLOSED_UNMERGED must remain non-success (exit 2), not CLEAN-equivalent.
Disposition: Bound remedy names MERGED as finish-success for wait owners (same exit 0 family as CLEAN for lifecycle proceed) and CLOSED_UNMERGED as fail-closed not-shipped; do not invent a third poller outside `pr:watch`.

## Through-merge mitigates Grok implement leaf only
footnote
Evidence: In-ceiling current-state 5857750642 and Stop 1 5857777796 already record that #4529/#4821 moves Grok implement off `pr:watch`, while Approach 1 and non-Grok `drive-to: merge-ready` leaves still block on it. Pin inventory confirms `pr:watch` still lacks MERGED/CLOSED_UNMERGED; skills still say Keep #4288 as the merged/closed terminal.
Failure mode: Treating through-merge alone as clearance would leave the SHA-match holdout hang on every remaining `pr:watch` owner.
Disposition: Context only — does not weaken the refutation target.

## Existing closer MERGED is a different verb
footnote
Evidence: `packages/core/src/pr-wait-mergeable/constants.ts` exports `EXIT_MERGED = 0`; `classify.ts` reads `partial_data.merged` for sibling-merge / closed paths on the squash-after-CLEAN closer. `pr-watch/constants.ts` has no `VERDICT_MERGED` / `VERDICT_CLOSED_UNMERGED`.
Failure mode: Harvesting only the closer leaves pre-CLEAN `pr:watch` waits exposed after human/sibling squash-merge.
Disposition: Inventory note — extend `pr:watch`; do not claim `pr:wait-mergeable` already discharges #4288.

Road-not-taken: Routing Approach 1 / human-merge observe to ad-hoc `pulls/<N>` outside `pr:watch` while leaving the verb unchanged. Rejected because skills pin Keep #4288 on `pr:watch`, non-Grok `drive-to: merge-ready` leaves block in-process on that verb, and `--one-shot` / JSON consumers would stay broken. Flip would require every wait owner to stop using `pr:watch` for finish — not observed at this SHA.

Refutation target (Stop 1 5857783919) survives.

Re-verified at pin `650ab1a614cd6049b4c70c2b48fa181ffef5455e` (`git rev-parse HEAD` matched; reads via `git show <sha>:<path>`). `probeOnce` resolves HEAD, Greptile body, and CI only — no `state`/`merged` fields on `WatchProbe`. `watch()` terminals in `constants.ts` are CLEAN / NEW_P0_P1 / ERRORED / CI_* / STALL / TIMEOUT / PENDING / CONFIG — no MERGED or CLOSED_UNMERGED. STALL advances only when `cleanGateHoldout !== "sha_match"` (#1259 / #2313), so an open re-review under `sha_match` correctly keeps polling; after squash-merge that same holdout still has no terminal arm and drains `--max-wait-minutes`.

## Early REST merged/closed before Greptile arms
sharpens-framing
Evidence: At the pin, `probeOnce` returns `errorProbe` when Greptile body fetch fails, before any terminal wait arm can fire. `fetchPrHeadShaRest` already `GET`s `repos/<owner>/<repo>/pulls/<N>` and parses only `head.sha`, discarding `state`/`merged` present on that payload. `pr-wait-mergeable/classify.ts` already splits `merged===true` → success vs closed-unmerged → non-success from the same forge facts.
Failure mode: A lean that adds MERGED/CLOSED_UNMERGED only after a successful Greptile score can still exit CONFIG on a merged/closed PR when the comment body path fails, so merge-path owners keep treating the wait as a probe fault instead of a finished PR.
Disposition: Bind the REST `state`+`merged` read early (extend the existing pulls/<N> parse; prefer one REST read). Named MERGED / CLOSED_UNMERGED must win over Greptile/SHA-match incompleteness and over Greptile-body CONFIG when the PR is already finished.

## Exit-0 MERGED is not CLEAN for squash start
sharpens-framing
Evidence: Issue Acceptance wants MERGED exit 0 (same numeric code as CLEAN) so drive-to / Approach 1 can proceed to `scope:complete`. Review-cycle / swarm skills at the pin require `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` only after CLEAN (`Wait-merge is squash-after-CLEAN`). `pr-wait-mergeable` already names MERGED and handles sibling-merged; `pr:watch` consumers that key only on exit code would not.
Failure mode: Shared merge-path wait authority changes: an exit-0-only consumer can treat human squash during `sha_match` holdout as CLEAN and start the squash closer, or claim Greptile CLEAN when only the PR finished.
Disposition: Keep the named verdict in the bind. MERGED finishes the wait for lifecycle (`scope:complete` / leftover finalize). CLEAN remains the only green light to start wait-merge squash. CLOSED_UNMERGED stays exit 2 on `pr:watch` (`EXIT_TERMINAL_ERROR`), matching Acceptance — do not copy wait-merge's closed-unmerged exit 1 mapping.

## Through-merge mitigation does not clear the hole
footnote
Evidence: Comment 5857750642 and Stop 1 already record that Grok through-merge (#4529/#4821) moves implement to `stop-at: pr-open`, while Approach 1 and non-Grok `drive-to: merge-ready` leaves still block on `pr:watch`. Pin code still lacks the terminals.
Failure mode: Treating through-merge as satisfaction would leave the measured hang on every remaining `pr:watch` owner.
Disposition: No change to the refutation target; harvest stays the named `pr:watch` arms.

## Open-PR sha_match holdout stays
footnote
Evidence: `watch.ts` STALL comment and streak gate at the pin explicitly exclude `clean_gate_holdout=sha_match`. Acceptance and Stop 1 P3 require keeping that open-PR guard; #4289 / Greptile HTML Last-reviewed stay non-goals.
Failure mode: Collapsing sha_match into STALL would false-terminal open re-review.
Disposition: Bind as keep-invariant beside the new arms; do not recut STALL exclusion.

metadata.issueBody:
## Problem

`task pr:watch` never reads whether the PR is **merged or closed**. `probeOnce` (`packages/core/src/pr-watch/probe.ts`) resolves HEAD SHA, Greptile body, and CI check-runs only. `watch()` (`packages/core/src/pr-watch/watch.ts`) terminals are CLEAN / NEW_P0_P1 / ERRORED / CI_* / STALL / TIMEOUT / PENDING. There is no merged/closed arm.

`clean_gate_holdout=sha_match` is **excluded from STALL** on purpose (#1259 / #2313): keep polling until cap while a re-review is in flight. After a human squash-merge that holdout is no longer "review in flight" — the PR is gone from the merge queue — but the poller still waits out `--max-wait-minutes` (default 30) as TIMEOUT/PENDING.

## Recurrence (measured 2026-09-09, PR 4287 / #4284)

- Operator squash-merged https://github.com/deftai/directive/pull/4287 at 2026-09-09T15:21:49Z (`merged=true`, `state=closed`, merge `0af0df41`).
- Greptile summary was 5/5, P0=0 P1=0, CI green. `pr:watch --one-shot` still printed:
  `PENDING` / `last_reviewed=<none>` / `sha_match=false` / `clean_gate_holdout=sha_match`
  because the thinner Greptile HTML comment has no `Last reviewed commit: <sha>` line (related detector gap; not this close).
- The `drive-to: merge-ready` Grok worker kept `pr:watch` until the parent killed it (~100 min). Merge was already done. `scope:complete` had to run from the parent.

## Acceptance

- `pr:watch` fetches PR `state` + `merged` (REST `repos/.../pulls/<N>`, not GraphQL `gh pr view --json`).
- **Merged** (`merged=true`) is a **terminal success** for the wait: named verdict (e.g. `MERGED`) that does **not** keep polling. Exit 0 (same as CLEAN) so a `drive-to: merge-ready` leaf proceeds to `scope:complete` instead of waiting out the cap. SHA-match / missing `Last reviewed commit` MUST NOT hold a merged PR.
- **Closed unmerged** (`state=closed` and `merged=false`) is a **terminal non-success** (exit 2, named e.g. `CLOSED_UNMERGED`). Not CLEAN. Worker must not treat it as shipped.
- Open PRs keep today's SHA-match stale-review guard.
- Regression tests: merged + sha_match false → MERGED exit 0 immediately; closed unmerged → exit 2; open + sha_match false → still PENDING/poll.
- Do not weaken the SHA-match guard on **open** PRs. Do not use GraphQL `gh pr view --json`.

## Non-goals

- Parsing Greptile's new HTML summary for `Last reviewed commit` (thinner reports since ~yesterday). File separately if needed.
- #4285 / #4286.
